description: A cloth strap for the head, which provides a weak protective force for the head. Head protection is the most important form of protection. Even in everyday life, one can see many people wearing a headband like this.
name: Linen Headband

description: A cloth neck strap, which envelopes the torso in a weak protective force. While the torso is heartier than the head, it is still of vital importance. Thankfully, a modest neck adornment almost never looks bad.
name: Linen Collar

description: A cloth strap for the upper arm, which defends both arms with a weak protective force field. One can live with arm damage, but it will make it difficult to do anything besides rest, making arm protection important for active individuals.
name: Linen Armband

description: A cloth strap for the waist, which covers both legs in a weak protective force field. While not many threats directly target the legs, damage inflicted upon them is quite literally crippling. Protect them, so that movement capabilities are not diminished.
name: Linen Belt

description: A pale silvery earring which re-enforces etherial defenses. Threats to the mind and soul are rarely encountered, but those that exist can erase one's very essence. Enchantments that defend from such threats can be life-saving if you expect to encounter them.
name: Pewter Earring

description: Personal armor designed to not only halt small calibur rounds, but also absorb the force of their impact. It provides some other minor defensive benefits, but they're not much to be relied on.
name: Ballistic Vest

description: Solid headgear designed to stop bullets and absorb impacts. It even provides decent damage against bladed weapons. A necessity for those expecting intense shootouts. However, it's conspicuousness will let people know you're up to something.
name: Ballistic Helmet

description: A cloth headband bearing a minor defensive enchantment, reducing damage from common attacks. Head protection is easily the most important sort of protection that one can wear, as a disabled head results in high stress and decreased spell effectiveness.
name: Headband

description: A cloth neck strap, bearing a minor defensive enchantment that protects the torso. The torso is roughly as important to defend as the head, since a disabled torso results in decreased performance across the board, as well as decreased movement.
name: Choker

description: Cloth wrist straps bearing a minor defensive enchantment. While arm damage typically isn't immediately fatal, a disabled arm will be much less effective at taking relevant actions. Flying and quadrupedal creatures also lose movement speed.
name: Wrist Bands

description: Cloth ankle straps bearing a minor defensive enchantment. Damaged legs result in both great stress, and decreased movement speed. Flying creatures ignore this, but their legs tend to function similar to terrestrial arms.
name: Ankle Bands

description: A silver ring with a small sapphire inlaid into it. Bears an enchantment that increases movement slightly.
name: Sapphire Ring

description: A silver ring with a small ruby inlaid into it. Bears an enchantment that increases melee and throwing power slightly.
name: Ruby Ring

description: A silver ring with a citrine quartz inlaid into it. Bears an enchantment that increases stress recovery and focus gain slightly.
name: Citrine Ring

description: A silver ring with a small emerald inlaid into it. Bears an enchantment that increases HP slightly.
name: Emerald Ring

description: A steel chain head adornment, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of mail armor.
name: Chain Headband

description: A steel chain necklace, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of mail armor.
name: Chain Necklace

description: Steel chain bracelets, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of mail armor.
name: Chain Bracelets

description: Steel chain anklets, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of mail armor.
name: Chain Anklets

description: A solid steel headband, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of plate armor.
name: Steel Diadem

description: A solid steel neck band, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of plate armor.
name: Steel Gorget

description: Solid steel bracelets, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of plate armor.
name: Steel Armlets

description: Solid steel anklets, bearing a defensive enchantment with the strength of plate armor.
name: Steel Anklets
